routing.specialist_policy: Load specialist skills only when the request or repo evidence clearly requires them. Prefer human-output for public copy and token-saver only when compression is explicit.
routing.manual_only_policy: Manual-only specialists should activate only from explicit wording or strong domain evidence, not from vague overlap.
routing.alias_policy: Deprecated alias skills remain for compatibility and should route to their replacement skill.
routing.evaluation_note: Routing benchmarks are task-fit and workflow proxies, not guarantees of answer accuracy. v1.9.5 adds reliability hardening, continuation, token measurement, tenant isolation, billing ops, observability, QA automation, PDPA privacy, cost control, customer success, prompt-injection defense, and eval-driven agent improvement.
